I won't be doing business with them again.

reviews.author: LA BELLA
reviews.review_text: Called Toyota Financial Services on 2-4-2022 at 10:11 am. Rep. Dian without an ID number from the moment she pick up the call had the WORSE attitude. Was extremely RUDE. She did not want to listen nor hear to what I had to say. If a customer is calling to get information it should not matter what time or day. All employees representing Toyota Financial, Toyota or any company under Toyota should be PLEASANT, GENTLE, MILD SPEAKING MANNER. Ms. DIAN WAS NOT THAT PERSON.

reviews.author: Lilly
reviews.review_text: I called Toyota Financial to make my scheduled payment on the 5th of every month (mind you that on the app and website I’m using to do autopay is set up for the 5th of every month but it’s pulling out every 27th). The representative said that he can’t do anything on his side because the app and websites are set up for self service, and that he has no access to viewing or changing my information. Now I’m thinking… Why does this Number exists if you can’t even help me or any caller? If they wanted me to find it out on my on they should have not supplied a contact line. Don’t waste your time calling with these people. They must be make good money by sitting on the butts and detouring loyal paying customers away.

reviews.author: Eleonora
reviews.review_text: Absolutely not helpful. Company's mistake resulted in my score dropping 80 points after I have been told it would not affect my score. When I called for explanation and them to fix it got no help and no acknowledgement of their mistakes. They were just saying same phrase on a loop. To be treated like that repeatedly in 2022 is absolutely unacceptable.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.review_text: Never again. Spent too many hours to count, on hold, calling my bank, lies and more lies, 4 months of phone calls, trying to pay my loan off. Saying electronically cashed checks didn't clear when I've got tracing #, the account of theirs, everything to prove payment but the check itself which they ask for knowing that they keep the checks and my bank does not get them back. Asking for merchant reports from my bank to fax them, my bank never heard of this. Then called back to find out now my account shows it posted. Please never use Toyota Financial. You'll be sorry. The whole system is messed up. Workers there must hate their jobs, they lie all the time, only a few will actually do their jobs.

reviews.author: Marco
reviews.review_text: Spoke with Toyota customer service so called Supervisor, regarding a mistake. They processed to be incorrect with my payment my money & called to correct it & all they can say is, "We are terribly sorry. We cannot do anything to correct it." In other words telling me too bad..

reviews.author: Mohamed
reviews.review_text: I had to write about my bad experience with Toyota, In August 2021 I did lease a vehicle under swap lease and until now I'm paying for a car that I can't drive because of The lack of service with paperwork!!

reviews.author: Barry
reviews.review_text: August 11 I sent a check for $9400 to pay off my RAV4 EV loan. That plus a $440 check that followed was in excess of what was owed. I heard nothing back waiting for a check and title. I called a few weeks later and found they had misapplied the funds. They misread the account number. Fine, they promised in a few days it would be fixed and I would get my title and check. Today after hearing nothing, I called and got some idiot who found all the records and unable to explain why the problem existed. He said they would have to sit on the funds for 10 days (funds that were cashiers checks weeks ago) and then in a month or two resolve it!!!! (If I am selling my car how does THAT work???) SO I get a resolutions person on the phone who says they will have information for me in 3-5 business days! WTF? What if I had failed a payment? I bet they act faster. They just do not care at all that they continue to screw up and I am left waiting for my pink slip!

reviews.author: C
reviews.review_text: Some advice: Do not finance your vehicle through Toyota Financial Services. Go through a local credit union or another institution you trust. Here's my story - in June of 2021 I began the process of buying out a lease. With used car prices spiking, it was a great time to purchase and resell, so I was eager to get through the process quickly. I called and spoke to a representative (after being on hold forever, as others have mentioned), who told me the payoff amount verbally and instructed me to just "pay it through the online portal and we'll send you the title." I should've realized that it was bizarre to send >$30k into the ether for a $400 monthly lease payment without any further information, but I did as instructed and waited... and waited... and got nothing. No email, no message, no title in the mail. After weeks, I called again and was told I'd be on hold for 90 minutes, so instead I sent a message through the online portal. After a few days, I got a response contradicting what I had been told on the phone. Not only was the amount they originally asked for incorrect (didn't include sales tax), but I would need to fill out a form and send payment via cashier's check instead of a digital payment. Meanwhile, the $30k I had already sent digitally was mysteriously marked as "credited" back to me, despite never actually being returned to my bank account. After asking for clarification, the rep sent me a digital payoff form and told me I would just have to send the difference (sales tax) as a cashier's check, and mail that along with the form. The amount "credited" would be applied towards the purchase, despite being supposedly the "wrong" way to pay. They then closed the online help ticket. I again did as instructed, but called again to check whether I would really need to send the sales tax by cashier's check. This time, after being on hold forever again, a different rep said I could just use the online portal to pay... contradicting the last rep... again. Wary now, I triple-checked, but they insisted it would be fine. So I sent the payment online and waited. After a couple more weeks (it's now late August 2021, so much for a quick turnaround), I received a letter saying my account had been sent to collections for "defaulting" on two lease payments (~$800), despite the fact that I had now sent them nearly $35k online to buy the rest of the lease and vehicle! Yes, I agree, it defies reason! I have now sent them yet another support request online seeking clarification after waiting 90 minutes on hold to no avail. It is truly baffling how hard Toyota has made it for me to purchase a vehicle. They are now holding an enormous amount of money ransom, while simultaneously claiming my account is somehow in default, and otherwise stonewalling me. They should absolutely be investigated for their incompetence, breach of contract, and borderline theft. Avoid these clowns at all costs!

reviews.author: MJ
reviews.review_text: I love my car but will refinance as soon as possible because I cannot deal with shady businesses. -The monthly “statement” they send gives no breakdown of where the payment is applied. As a consumer you have no idea what was applied toward principal or interest unless you call. After spending 48 minutes on hold I was told there is no more detailed statement you can request and if you want a breakdown you have to call for it. -You cannot pay any extra each month and have it apply toward principal. When I called to request this after realizing they were applying my extra funds to future payments I was given a recorded message explaining the 3 manual ways principal payments can be made. -When I asked for the upcoming payment and how much of that is principal VS. interest they hung up on me. -The service person talked over me during the entire call. It was unacceptable. It was clear she had an agenda to follow and there is nothing service oriented about how she handled my questions. This is easily the worst customer service in the business. Huge fail.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.review_text: It took TF two weeks to process my lease end payoff. Despite nearly daily calls to their "customer service" reps, they never sped things up. I gave them my express mail acct, but they sent title by snail mail.

reviews.author: Erik
reviews.review_text: You would think that after paying off a car, the title would soon follow. This is not the case with me. Long story short, I paid off my car 2.5 years ago. I have a letter from Toyota stating that vehicle was paid in full. The only problem is they have not sent the DMV or me the certificate of lien release. When I called the DMV, they said it is electronic and they can't send me title without Toyota sending them the certificate of lien release. Of course when I try to call Toyota, there is a long hold. I can't wait 3 hours to talk to a person. Why they don't have a call back system for long waits such as 3 hours, is beyond me. Further, why is it on me to prompt them to do their part? Toyota, great cars, poor financial management department.

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.review_text: I’ve been calling for over two hours, I traded in my vehicle and the dealership wants me to call Toyota Financial Services to let them know since payment is due next week. But no one is answering the damn phone. And it’s been over two hours. What the hell is going over there that they can’t answer the phone. This is ridiculous, when I first call I get the automated system. I go thru all these steps to get a real person just so knows answer the phone and then get lit on hold for over two hours. This is not right. Someone needs to step in and throw down the hammer.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.review_text: As everyone knows there is a CURRENT global pandemic. I am a Toyota customer and was directly affected. Besides losing my job, I also contracted Covid in 2020. When you have Covid, you can’t go to work until you test negative. This can take several weeks. I spoke to Toyota Financial and asked to make a payment arrangement as I was not working due to the pandemic. They agreed. Little did I know they were going to destroy my hood credit by saying my payment (which was part of an agreement) was late. At the time I made the arrangement, they also didn’t tell me that I can make a partial payment, and this would be ok! They put me through a long tedious process of submitting disputes in writing, which I sent certified ($$). Then asked to RE-submit by fax ($). And then call and call desperately trying to navigate the broken IVR (the voice that asks you describe your issue in 3 words or less, but never understands) for weeks and retell every person about your crappy 2020, just to be told to call back. This company is deceptive. And I guess most companies that make money off regular people are. But to tell me “We provided courtesy removals DURING the pandemic, but this is outside of that window” is a slap in the face to someone who actually had the virus. The pandemic isn’t over. You should be more consistent and considerate with the global situation. (Steps off soapbox)

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.review_text: Trust me. Just don’t use autodraft through this company! My local water provider does a better job..., Very disappointed since I love Toyota trucks & cars so much. Shouldn’t have the Toyota named attached to this service!!

reviews.author: Armin
reviews.review_text: I have been keeping a log of the poor service that is provided by Toyota Financial Services. Let's begin with the poor runaround telephone automated system they use. After waiting periods of a stated 21 minutes or 41 minutes I still waited longer. You may ask why did I wait, it is because they applied my final payoff amount of $4,229.72 to another account or could not figure out where they applied the funds. My check to Toyota was sent to Toyota at the end of January 2021 and paid by my bank on Feb. 4, 2021 but they sent me a bill at the end of Feb. for the February payment. That's when I knew something was wrong. I have called them 6 -8 times speaking to various representatives who know very little or place you on hold and don't come back. I had to send them a 9 page fax outlining all my efforts, copies of the bank statement and check, copies of the payoff notice and statement. I requested that someone call me with follow up info that day. I waited a day and NO call or follow-up. I had to call again and ask for the number or supervisor who is handling my account. When calling the "RESOLUTION DEPARTMENT" today the rep "wanted to know how I got this number." He went on to say notation was made and still being processed. If they want their money I expect the service I paid for. Never again will I involve myself with Toyota.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.review_text: So what you will learn about Toyota is if you're late two or three months but pay on time for the current month they will put that payment towards a late month and report that you have not made a payment for the current month and charge you late fees and mess up your credit. Even if you request said payment go toward that current month, they'll still screw you over and tax on bunch of late fees making it impossible to catch up. I pay another car and they report a month missing if you miss a payment but report any payment for the current month Southland credit Union great financing company. What Toyota is doing is false reporting and fraud. Be careful.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.review_text: I recently moved from FL to Long Island NY. I needed to register My 2017 Toyota Tacoma. I first called Toyota Customer for instruction. I was told to utilize a standard Toyota letter to present to NY DMV for registration. DMV rejected this. They informed me I needed a “certified copy of the title” & a letter of authorization to register my Toyota in NY. I called Toyota customer service & was told they would email a copy of the Certified Title directly to the local DMV. Try also promised to send the letter authorization letter to register my vehicle to my new address. I asked to have it mailed overnight. The rep told me he was not authorized to do this unless I could produce a UPS or FedX account number. I asked him to email a copy of the letter to me. He promised to both things. He did neither!!! I called customer service the next day & basically was told it was not done & the correct procedure was not followed. I reminded her I followed the procedure they told me. I asked to speak to a supervisor & was told the rep needed to “email” the supervisor with a request to call me. I stated this was unacceptable. They told me I was being transferred to the “dispute resolution” department. After being on hold for approximately 20 to 30 minutes I hung up. I tried again the third day & was told a new story.! They told me NYDMV needed to request the “Certified Copy of the Title directly from Toyota. I went to DMV with this information & was politely they do not do this. I asked again to be transferred to the dispute resolution department. After 30 minutes I hung up. The first rep gave me bad information. The reps day 2 & 3 were rude & frankly dishonest. Toyota makes a great product but Toyota Financial needs to understand the customer matters. As I write this my issues are not resolved. Tom **

reviews.author: Sarabeth
reviews.review_text: I have never had so many issues with one comapny as I have with Toyota Financial. In addition to being told different things by different representatives the representatives are really awful to deal with. If you have any type of complaint you can forget getting any help. They are very defensive about their practices and never accept responsibility. They have been terrible to deal with during the pandemic. The deferral process was a nightmare. Then I made an error by not returning a form even though they had told me my deferral was in place so who is expecting a next step but there was and I missed it and now I have been fined by them and had my credit destroyed. I am looking to turn in this lease to a different company. I want to be rid of Toyota for good.

reviews.author: Karissa
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, I had high hopes for Toyota Financial. I figured with their reliable vehicles they would also be a reliable finance company. Wow was I wrong. They denied all covid extensions I needed. My cars got repoed and they threatened to keep my personal belongings. They told the repo yard to not give me my belongings. I had to get the police involved in which the repo yard then allowed me to get my property. Toyota agent kept telling me “I don’t care about what the police says it’s our policy” as if their policy is higher than the law. Very sad. I’m only 19 years old by the way and they approved me for 150k worth of auto loans and my Each of my vehicle payments Were over $800 a month. I will never be financing a vehicle again due to my experience

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.review_text: After paying off my 2009 Camry, I noticed inaccurate late payments had been applied to my credit profile. I submitted multiple disputes, and to no avail, each inquiry would result in more fraudulent and fictitious late payments reported being reported to the credit bureaus. To get this situation remedied and/or resolved, I submitted one final dispute on 12/22/2019. The results of the investigation rendered a delinquent status being applied to my paid off account in full. These retaliatory and predatory lending practices has negatively affected my credit worthiness, and quality of life. As a former loyal customer, I demand a amicable resolution, as I've purchased 2 vehicles from Toyota. I no longer believe Toyota's products, the customer service is horrendous, and the lending practices are unethical. I will never do business with another Toyota establishment again. I've received several invitations and pre-approvals to purchase another vehicle from Toyota. I am not interested. This company needs to be investigated.

reviews.author: Nathan
reviews.review_text: Inept customer service cost me money, time, and stress. Two times SETF sent notification letters to me AFTER a due date. First I was sent a notification that I needed to complete a Lessee Affidavit swearing that my vehicle is for personal use only, not business use. They mailed this notification after the due date for the form. I ended being taxed by my county, which cost me over $1000. The second feat of incompetence came recently, when my car is nearing the end of its lease. I was sent a notification that I’d be contacted by AutoVin for the turn in inspection, around 60 days before the end of my lease. I never got a call from AutoVin and this SETF notice was mailed to me past that time frame and leading into the Christmas/New Year holidays. I wasn’t able to talk with anyone at SETF (after waiting for multiple 1 hour hold times). So now my lease is coming to an end (two weeks), I need to get a new car, and I’m just now getting an appointment with AutoVin (whom I had to call). Terrible and incompetent company. I wouldn’t be surprised if they mail these notifications late to try to get late fees from people.

reviews.author: Karriem
reviews.review_text: No direct number to live support.. In order to speak to a person you have to blindly wade through an automated labyrinth with no logical rhyme or reason.. Next, you have to deal with people that know very little except how to receive a payment...!!!

reviews.author: ibrahim
reviews.review_text: Toyota finance did not accept to give me extensions during the coronavirus when I lost my job due to covid 19 and they repo my car while most of the banks give a lot of extensions to their customers, it’s seem to me they making money when they repo the car because I paid 3 years out of my auto loan so all interest rate it’s been paid so if they repo my car they will make the rest of the money right away without waiting for the next 3 years payment on my car, they are such a greedy people who have this policy against their customers. And the customer service so rude if you don’t speak their Alabama accent then they will treat you so bad over the phone and you are not consider to be a human being on the situation we have in our country because they will take advantage on you no matter what’s going on with the coronavirus.

reviews.author: robert
reviews.review_text: Purchased my 4Runner in Sept. Agreed to "finance" for the $750 military credit. Finally received my notice for payments and website directions. Went to the website to pay off the car. None of the buttons work. All come back as "We are experiencing difficulty. Try back later". So, I try over a week to give them a chance. No joy! So, I use the phone system to obtain my payoff balance and submit that through the website. Get an email noting the payment and that it had been received. However, no evidence on the account online that any payment has been made. Try the "contact us" button - you can fill in the spots but nothing sends. Called and the wait is 30 minutes. So, while waiting I thought I'd submit a few reviews. Feel free to buy a Toyota but DO NOT use TFS. They do not have their act together. Totally slipshod. If it weren't associated with the vehicle I would have posted this as a scam.

reviews.author: First
reviews.review_text: I leased a vehicle via Toyota Financial Services, all payments made on time and I had never even had the need to contact TFS over the 14 months I had been making payments on time. Then suddenly and unexpectedly I was laid off. I called TFS to see if it was possible to defer a payment or two until I had steady income coming in. TFS claimed that in order to defer a payment I would need to pay a $150 fee in advance. Im sorry but if a customer has made all payments on time and is proactive in seeking assistance rather than defaulting on all payments then I think it be advantageous to allow this fee to be included with the scheduled deferred payment. What genius executive came up with this needs to be terminated and hired at a debt collection firm where that sort of poor business acumen and ideology would be accepted. Absolutely ridiculous and it shows a customer where they stand and what little value they have. My suggestion is steer clear of Toyota Financial Services and Toyota as a whole seeing how they are part of Toyota. Toyota makes a great product but what's the incentive in purchasing if you are simply an account number and if and when a bad situation might occur you will be left out to dry like a red headed step child. I learned the hard way and will never even consider a Toyota product again.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services was managing my Lexus Lease. I doubt many people will read this before deciding to lease a Lexus. All I can say is that they do not treat their clients well. They are a terrible company with egregious customer service. Lease another luxury car if you can.

reviews.author: Debbie
reviews.review_text: I have been a Toyota customer for years, with good experiences with the sales department. I just had a car accident (another driver ran a red light), and my 2020 Yaris (driven 450 km) was a total loss. I lease my cars from Toyota. I don’t drive many miles, and I trade my cars in after 4 years. My new monthly lease payment is always reduced by the equity on my trade-in. The equity reflected in my lease payments on the 2020 Yaris was $2200, though I’m sure Toyota profited more than this. Insurance paid Toyota the full replacement value of my 2020 Yaris, but Toyota is refusing to apply the equity which it enjoyed to my new lease payments, or to refund the equity.

reviews.author: Joshua
reviews.review_text: Me and my wife bought a new Toyota in June 2019. We got it financed through Toyota Financial. Never had a problem until July, August and September of 2020. I got a email about my credit report that said that Toyota reported that I was 30 days late on my payment for each of the last 3 months. I sent them proof from my Toyota account that showed every month was paid on time (even tho they can see that) and I sent proof from my bank that showed it. I asked them if they could remove those from my credit report since I showed plenty of proof that it was paid on time. They denied it and said nothing they could do. So now I have 3 remarks on my credit report that dropped my score over 50 points. I’ll probably just refinance my loan somewhere else even if I do have to pay more a month.

reviews.author: Lucy
reviews.review_text: My family and I have driven Toyotas our entire lives. The cars are great but Toyota Financial's customer service center is so very horrific (and in every possible way) that I will not buy another Toyota again. That is how frustrated I am. The customer care people don't know what they're talking about. Their automated service is horrific. And there's no one you can write to. They supposedly have an email service, and you write and wait for them to write you back and guess what? An automatic generated message is delivered that basically tells you to call. The call center gave me the wrong information! This is utter disrespect for your customers, to not have a means of helping them! All I want to do is make an international payment and no one can help me. It's utterly infuriating. I'm calling long distance and it takes me forever to get through and one false move they cut you off and you have to start all over again. And when you get someone they give you the wrong information. I've always had a hard time with their service but this time, I AM DONE. And there's no one you can write to. You just lost a life time customer Toyota. All because you don't care about the quality of the customer service you're giving me.

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.review_text: Returned a 2014 RAV4 and forgot to include the cargo cover. Called 2 days later asking to return it, denied the request. Receive an invoice in the mail stating it would be $500 to replace the part. Upon inspection on the Toyota parts website, the MSRP on the part is $130 which we would have been happy to pay. Phone rep lied to us, stating that the price of $130 is if you want an extra cargo cover, but the initial part cost them $500. If they bought one to replace the missing one after we turned it in, it would have cost them $130. They said they would review and get back to us. It's now been 4 months of not hearing from them and today we get a call that we still owe $500. Not happening and we're not paying. Reporting this to the BBB. Do not consider Toyota for your lease options.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.review_text: Be careful of late payments! They have no remorse in coming to take their vehicle away from your driveway while you sleep during a Global Pandemic!!! Score another point for big corporations and another negative for the average person during all this BS!

reviews.author: Haley
reviews.review_text: Zero stars if I could. Worst experience. They misguided me multiple times in the process of getting a lien-release on a vehicle from a prior owner which delayed the process of my issue being resolved, they refused my calls, and refused to let me speak to managers to escalate the urgent matter.

reviews.author: Mirza
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services are a bunch of crooks. I had requested an extension on an over mileage payment after my lease ended due to COVID and certain financial constraints. The request was granted, great. A month later I sent them the payment as promised. They called me every day for 5 days straight harassing me and saying they didn’t get the payment. They said they would send me a complete invoice and I have yet to receive it. Unlike other financial companies, they are corrupt pigs that don’t give a crap about what your financial situation despite a worldwide pandemic. Corporate greed is their motto and will do anything to get their money, but won’t help you out when you need it. DO NOT do business with them. Wish I could give them negative stars.

reviews.author: Jamie
reviews.review_text: Customer service has inaccurate balances, fees and monthly payments showing on my account for the past 3 months. Nobody can seem to help fix. Left on hold for over an hour today just to get hung up on.

reviews.author: Jasmina
reviews.review_text: I tried to make a principal only payment online only to be directed to call a number and talk to an agent to make a principal only payment. Ok, I can do this. When I did they still took interest on the payment. I called again to inquire and they said they would put a memo that it was principal only and fix it. A week later and no fix. I called again and they said it would be 10-15 working days for principal only payments to post as such. How can I be expected to keep up with what they are doing interest wise if they delay payments in such a way. I make payments of some form every two weeks, always exceeding my payment amount. I want to pay the car off early and not get ripped off by by a company that should post a payment if submitted according to their guidelines. They ae obscuring the situation which forces you to trust they are processing payments in your best interest when you would be hard-pressed to prove if they didn't. For such a good car company the financial side is less than transparent.

reviews.author: Stacy
reviews.review_text: My review isn’t so much about my Toyota Tacoma, although it is the best truck I’ve ever owned. It tows my boat, it’s comfortable for my whole family, it has never broke down on me, and it looks awesome. This review is mostly about the service I have gotten since buying my truck for years ago. I finance through Toyota Financial and last year I came down with a pretty nasty bout of cancer. Without even hesitation Toyota Financial let me slide on about five payments. And then This year with the coronavirus, and me losing my job, Toyota once again without question has let me slide on these last three payments. This is a huge thank you to Toyota for an amazing product and service above and beyond. Thank you so much and I will be buying Toyota for the rest of my days I guarantee you that.

reviews.author: Niptippog
reviews.review_text: Today 05/26/2020 time: 12.20 pm I talk with customer service. I explain, last month I didn't get statement. I ask customer service help me remove late charge for me because that is not my fault. She talk very fast and say no everything. She look like angry me, talk very loud. I am not happy. Bad service. Niptippog

reviews.author: Mickayla
reviews.review_text: Since the beginning, I have had to call to make a payment on my car. When I'm supposed to be able to do that myself on the Toyota Financial app, never worked. In the beginning of the year, I could not afford the car anymore, so I'm trying to do a voluntary repo. I went to a manager at Toyota and I've called Toyota financial. I have told both areas that I want a voluntary repo because I cannot afford it anymore, because of me having no job. I believe it has been two to three months, where my car has been still sitting at my parent's house, and they are still charging me monthly payments. After they told me they weren't, and that they would put a hold on the account. I have been nice. I have been compliant, I have been on hold a couple of times for almost an hour or two. It's like they're ignoring me now, and my family have been loyal customers for years. This is all towards Toyota financial, and not the Toyota dealership, because I have brought this to my agent, my agent has talked to them, and they even had issues with Toyota financial. And I'm just going to leave it at this...

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.review_text: They lie and give you wrong information and they told me that I have a grace period to pay and don’t honor that. Then they tell they close at centennial hours and they lie about that too so be cautious with what they tell if you don’t have it paper then is as if they said nothing otherwise you will be like me and get hit on your credit report for their misled information.

reviews.author: Goaddy
reviews.review_text: Anyone who has a Toyota Financial account will know this all too well. First off, will never buy a Toyota again. First off, every 30 seconds you get locked out of the online system to make a payment. They give you 5 minutes to get your code number and then sends the emails 1/2 hour later. When you get someone on the line that's ** and they hear a ** person, they keep on lying left and right. They keep lying saying online payments take 5 days to process which is an outright lie. Every time you want the account unlocked, they are more interested in stealing the money. You ask them to unlock the account account. They go back to waiting the payment. You hang up and there's an hour wait time. Hang up again there's a one hour and half. You waste your time with this company and the games they play.

reviews.author: Erika
reviews.review_text: Prior to purchasing my vehicle, I did copious amounts of research. I saw that cool, they have a military rebate for those who are retired. Note: the website states specifically that retirees are eligible for this discount, regardless of time separated from service. Good deal. I brought this information into the dealership with me, and go figure, there's so much more red tape to that rebate. Apparently, toyota.com and toyotafinancialservices.com are two totally separate entities, and while it even states on the toyota.com website that you must be credit approved through Toyota Financial Services (TFS) in order to be eligible for such a rebate, TFS has something completely different available to them. You must be a retiree with two years out of service... so naturally, like any other consumer, I can only go off of what is available to me on the public website. Since there was a discrepancy with what is online and available to TFS and the Customer Experience Center (CEC), what I saw online doesn't matter. I spent countless hours over the span of a month and some change going back and forth with the dealership, TFS, CEC and finally the TFS Executive Group, only to learn that I can basically kick rocks because that's not what TFS shows on their side (recall the retiree regardless of time separated from the service), and that they'll have the website updated, the dealership would not give you an additional rebate on top of the manufacturer rebate for year end purchase (they sure as hell were, which is why I even bothered wasting my time in the first place), thank you have a great life. If you look at the flyer on the toyota.com website, you will see that there is indeed no time constraint. Even though I brought this up, TFS is NOT willing to budge. Literally everyone I spoke with over the multiple cases opened, to include the Customer Relations Manager at the dealership agreed too, that I rate it, TFS should give me the rebate, and they most definitely need to fix their website. Even better news... literally nobody over there, from TFS to the CEC, understands the damn difference between SCRA and the retiree rebate. I had to explain multiple times that I do not rate SCRA benefits because I am out of the service and that's not even relevant, but let me tell you, they kept referring to a case where the rep put me in for SCRA benefits and I didn't even ask for them. The rep who helped me today, who called from the Executive Group, kept referring to that nonsense and basically dismissed me stating that they would talk to the dealership and ensure it doesn't happen to anyone else. I said, "YOU NEED TO FIX THE WEBSITE. THAT IS INCREDIBLY MISLEADING." Instead, he in not these exact same words, that I should basically "go ** myself," and they could give two ** less because they already got my contract. Thanks Toyota Financial Services! I'm excited how you don't honor what's on the toyota.com website, and have people go through flaming hoops to get what they feel they rate (I clearly met all of the criteria per the toyota.com website), and tell them to kick rocks. I appreciate you supporting the military! It's been a fantastic experience! Note the dripping sarcasm. This experience has been a flaming dumpster fire and I most definitely DO NOT recommend this company. Get approved through your credit union and spare yourself a headache. Thanks.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.review_text: Please run away from this company. Easily you can be on hold for 50-60 minutes and nobody knows what they are doing. They send a wrong statement which resulted in overpaying a month. A whole month and still waiting for a refund check, spoken with 10+ people and still nothing is been resolved.

reviews.author: John
reviews.review_text: At this point, especially after reading other similar reviews. I don't know how this company has not been raided by the FBI for financial fraud. I have now contacted via phone and email for a month about a 4500 principal payment I made. Keep in mind they do not have an option where you can pay principal online. This is the only financial institution I have ever dealt with where you cannot pay principal online. You have to call that in or submit via message support. I have now contacted the 7x over this matter and every time I get the same answer. Please allow 3-5 business days. And every single time they do not apply the payment. This company is greedy and all they want to do is collect all the interest possible!! Everything is well documented and they still don't care. They just tell you what you want to hear but never do it. I believe this company is trained to do that as most corrupt companies do.

reviews.author: BIL
reviews.review_text: I wish I can give them 100 Negative Star. If you want to payment your principal they will apply toward your future installment to force you to pay interest. For Little issue I call them 10 times. Every time new Story. Steal my payment for principal reflecting in my future installment. They are big Cheater. Purposely they do to earn interest by hook & crook. I will never deal with Toyota in Future.

reviews.author: Penelope
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services as a corporate entity works fairly well but when something goes wrong and the customer needs special service, it can't handle it. I recently received a text saying they had not got my February payment. I usually don't need to pay any attention to this as I have Toyota set up in my bill pay system to respond automatically when the ebill comes into my bank's system. I immediately called my bank and they had not sent a payment because they had not received an ebill! So I called Toyota to pay the Feb bill by credit card so that I could see what I could do about future bills later. The representative insisted I pay by giving her all my account info on my checking account! I asked to pay by credit card but for some reason her system would not accept my credit card (we tried 2)! This is absolutely unacceptable! Then she said she would send me a receipt and, of course, I was never sent the receipt so I have no way of knowing whether I was credited with the February payment or not. I am more than frustrated!

reviews.author: Glennys
reviews.review_text: My family and I have been long time customers of Toyota. Most have been financed through Toyota Financial. Every time there is something we need help with, customer service never seems to HELP. They always tell you what you already know and they stay quiet waiting for you. Today I called asking them for help because the payment I sent out wasn't received at their facility. We currently have two Toyota cars that we are paying and one had gone through in time so we are expecting the other to be paid as well since the payments are sent out at the same time. The customer service rep just kept repeating for me to check my bank if it has been charged/charged and I repeatedly told her that it has not been charged or else I would be speaking to my bank and not Toyota financial. She then proceeds to tell me the process of how payments are done. I didn't ask how it's processed, I asked for help. I asked for options but instead the rep just kept telling me information I already knew. This is why I call customer service cause I need help. Called today 01/28/2020 @11: 24 am. Spoke to a female rep. Pull up her calls and tell me she did her job? Useless.

reviews.author: Teng
reviews.review_text: Called Toyota Financial for payoff support and was received with a very rude customer service representative named Alex. I'm not sure why he was so abruptly rude as soon as the call started. Was on hold for 30 minutes before I actually spoke to him. After being rude, I requested to speak with a supervisor and he put me on hold. He came back to tell me that they were with other customers. I requested for a call back and to continue to be on hold for the supervisor. After 5-10 minutes he disconnected the call. I called back and was put on hold for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, to what sounded like a pick up call from a representative. I was once again hung up on. I'm not sure what's going on and why I was being treated as if I am incompetent. I just wanted clarification that my payoff will be good and the daily interests will not hold me back since on the website it did not post. The payment was taken out of my bank account already. I really hope they revisit the recording to today's call and re-train their employees on how to be better at assisting customers. I also hope they address this individual on his behavior as well. I wanted to end with Toyota financial on a good note and to hopefully continue doing business with them in the future. But with today's Customer service call with Toyota financial we've ended on a bad experience. Lesson learned. If they treat customers like this, why would I want or anyone want to continue to do business with them. This representative, Alex is a bad reflection on Toyota. I'm so disappointed. Called again and spoke with another representative name Lina. She was great and informative. She gave me a peace of mind. I just did not want to allow one bad seed to deter me from getting clarification. I'm glad I didn't allow him to do that to me. I ended up getting an awesome representative who assured me of my concerns.

reviews.author: natalie
reviews.review_text: Turned in my lease a week before it was up. Decided to not get another Toyota at the time because of the cost. Well, two months later I get a negative credit report saying I am almost 60 days past due on my bill. I called Toyota and was told sorry they never closed out my account when I turned in my lease. They did contact the credit bureaus and fix the error. Then several months later I get a bill from them telling me I owe them reimbursement taxes on fees they paid to Virginia during the time in which they accidentally left my account active. So I call them and they say "ma'am yes this is our error and we truly apologize but YOU have to contact the commissioner's office to let them know when you turned in the vehicle so that we can be reimbursed". OMG What a mess this has been. So I "the customer whose acct you never closed out properly" have to go around making calls so that Toyota can be reimbursed for a tax bill they paid while the car was in their possession??

reviews.author: Vincent
reviews.review_text: I've been using Toyota Financial for years and I will no longer use them or Toyota ever again. They cost me 80 points on my credit due to an error with the dealership and my billing address. Mind you I set my vehicles up through Toyota Financial Autopay. I've done this with my past 4 leases with them. Apparently they don't care about their customers as no letters or phone calls were sent informing me of late payment. Garbage. I'd highly recommend looking elsewhere for financing.

reviews.author: Dmitry
reviews.review_text: Their system had a glitch or something, charged me twice, one day and then on the next day again, I called and they said "we still don't see it in our system so we can't stop this payment". Then a support specialist just closed my written case with no explanation of why the charge occurred, just said "we helped you over the phone, this case is closed". But they didn't help or resolve anything, wtf. Totally ignorant staff at their support center... I'm still talking to them to find out the reason of this glitch.

reviews.author: Patty
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services made it very easy for me to lease a Toyota. And all went well with a few bumps until the end of my lease. Then, for some unknown reason, the website refused to accept my payments for the final few months. This required a call to TFS and a very frustrating, really very very frustrating phone tree. It takes forever to get through to a real person. Finally, there is a real person. Many apologies; problem solved. Until the next month when the payment is rejected and the whole process is repeated. And again the next month. Finally, I called to see about buying the car. I only wanted information since I had not yet lined up the financing and I certainly WASN'T going through them again. They immediately sent out the paperwork which was nearly expired by the time I got it. I did the phone tree again. They sent out more paperwork. I paid off the car and waited for the title. It never came. Phone tree again. Oops, the title is lost in the mail. They will send a release of lien and I can pay for a duplicate title. The release came and I went to the DMV. Paperwork rejected because TFS "forgot" to have it notarized. More phone tree. TFS is so so so sorry. They will send out more paperwork and also give a gift visa card for $100. That made me feel better. The new paperwork came and time will tell if the DMV accepts it. The visa gift cards came but without any pin number, so it cannot be used. People, this has been going on for 2 1/2 months. This is their business. How can they not have a clue on how to do things???? AVOID THIS COMPANY.

reviews.author: eduard
reviews.review_text: Rude customer service regarding customer service with multiple mistakes on service for three cars. I would put the lowest of the lowest, do not use at all. They make multiple mistakes attaching payments to the account. Come out with daycare children excuses. Representative do not care if customer is happy or satisfied.

reviews.author: Harry
reviews.review_text: I will never finance any Toyota again with Toyota Financial as they have made so many errors regarding providing me with a clear title for my 2019 Toyota Camry Hybrid which is sitting in my garage because the registration expired and I am yet to obtain title to the car because of their numerous errors. When they submitted the title to the DMV to clear the title in my name when I fully paid off my car loan it got bounced because they failed to pay DMV adequate registration fees. After this error even though I paid the car off in full they then put the wrong name on the title so even though I paid the loan off in full I am still unable to register and or drive the car due to Toyota Financials's numerous errors. I have never had this problem before with any other finance companies obtaining a clear title in my name after my loan pay off.

reviews.author: Oleksandra
reviews.review_text: I have Toyota after I leased a vehicle from them. They steal my money. Their customer service reps have 0 professionalism. I talk to them more often than I talk to my mom. They pretend to pay my fines and tickets (which they don't), then I receive late payments fines from local DMVs, pay them all personally, and Toyota claims I owe them money too. This company will rob you, DO NOT do business with them.

reviews.author: A.
reviews.review_text: I have leased several vehicles in the last eight years through Honda, Chevy, GMC, and Toyota. I have nothing against the vehicle. I actually loved that Toyota Rav4 but we needed a larger vehicle. In July 2019, we turned in the Rav4 a couple of weeks early. I asked the man who took the keys if we had any charges or fees that we needed to take care of and was told "no". Fast forward to today - three months later - and all of a sudden we owe almost $900. We had nothing in our emails, mail, or phone calls in the meantime. Did you know that if your full name isn't in your voicemail, they won't leave you one? Supposedly, we are allowed to have a 3rd party assess damages within 60 days. Due to the three month delay, we have no recourse to correct the "quarter-sized" scratch on the right side of the vehicle except to pay $238. I guarantee a local shop could have taken care of it for half the cost. I will NEVER lease a vehicle from Toyota or Lexus again. The customer service when you no longer own their vehicle is atrocious. They need to a) better train their staff on walking customers through what the process is at the end of a lease and b) honor what their employees say.

reviews.author: J.
reviews.review_text: 71 mos ago financial process went smoothly. It was at the end of the contract, being overcharged on last payment. Customer service nonexistent. Rep Shannon rude, unprofessional, Posed an inquiry she rudely responded by repeating information I already knew, no assistance whatsoever. Two other inquiries were met with the same response from Shannon. Not even an offer to escalate the issue, Contacted another office, customer care manager was supposed to call that same day or next. Ms. ** called 4 days later, after business hours. I called the number she provided the next day, was left on hold. Needless to say she didn't bother to call back. Issue not resolved although Shannon decided to close the case as RESOLVED. Unreal. I then decided to contact the corporate offices and stated my complaint, that fell on deaf ears as well. As of today it has been eight (8) days and no one has bothered to acknowledge receipt of my correspondence. Because, I believe no paying customer should be ignored, nor treated so rudely, I will never go back to Toyota.

reviews.author: Christine
reviews.review_text: My two-year old Toyota Corolla was totaled on June 17, 2019. Toyota Financial posted payment from my insurance company on July 24, 2019. It is now Sept. 24, 2019 and Toyota's total loss department has yet to close out the claim. I have gap insurance. They told me today that it will take another 3 to 6 weeks to "cancel my warranties" from Toyota with will then provide me a partial refund. This partial refund will be applied to what I still owe on the car but since I have gap insurance I should not still owe anything. I have had to continue to make monthly payments to Toyota since the crash (as of today I have made 4 payments) so that my credit will not be dinged while Toyota Financial tries to do what they are supposedly professionals at doing. They told me that I do not need to make payments while they are working on the claim but it will still go on my credit report as a negative. Toyota Financial told me that once the claim is closed out they will contact the credit agencies and "fix everything" for me. REALLY? Do you think I trust them to do anything right? How long should it take to complete a claim. In the meantime, I have had to buy another vehicle which I am also making payments on. Toyota said they will reimburse the payments I am making--that remains to be seen--I really do not trust them at all. Every time I call them I am given a different person who has a different answer to my questions. They are sweet as sugar on the phone but as incompetent as a 3 year old.

reviews.author: Ken
reviews.review_text: I have had 7 Toyotas in the last 13 years. The first 2 were purchased and financed through Toyota Financial, the last 4 were leases also financed through Toyota Financial Services. Let me start by saying all of the cars were great. Excellent vehicles. The purchases were problem free. The leases have been 1 headache after another. It's shocking to me that this is even the same company. The vast majority have come from property taxes which they have no idea how to bill correctly. In the last 3 years I have spent upwards of 15 hours on the phone with customer service trying to straighten out problems which they created. Time after time I was assured they were corrected, apologies were issued over and over, and a month later we had to go through it all again. More recently I turned in a lease in February and because of my "customer loyalty" they waived the disposition fee. Except they apparently forgot and have called me, always after 7:30 at night, in July, August and now September asking for the payment. Thank god I have kept records of who I spoke with and the dates for all of these. I was shocked tonight, although by now I shouldn't be to get yet another call asking me to once again pay the disposition fee that had been waived multiple times already. When the rep looked into my files and saw the notes she changed her request saying she was collecting for property taxes. Feeling highly skeptical at this point I asked her to send it all to me in writing which she replied "Toyota/Lexus is not set up to do that." She actually got noticeably ruder at this point and began talking over me and even said "I'm just gonna note here that you're refusing to pay." I am completely shocked at this point. I would highly advise anyone thinking of using Toyota Financial Services to think again. There are many far better options out there. Again, the cars have all been exceptionally good. But the lack of professionalism, inability to handle simple billing problems and now refusal to provide me requested documentation in writing leads me to the conclusion that the best advice I can give anyone is to not let their problems become your problems. Steer clear or you may learn the hard way.

reviews.author: Victoria
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial has terrible customer service. I have leased two cars from them for over 5 years. They are just terrible. When you call customer service and complain they do absolutely nothing about it. They don't even write it down, they fake listen. They don't tell you they will take care of it, or anything like that. They ask "is there anything else". I have requested change of titles because I move yearly. They ALWAYS give me hard time about it, and lie by saying they are going to send it to you, but they never do. They want Motor Vehicles to request it, but Motor Vehicles want them to send it. The battle starts then and the customer is in between. I called them early enough to update the address, and speed up the title change they started charging me increased amount of money from the day I called. I was still in the old state. When you ask to speak with superior they say "they are at the meeting" each time. And they keep you on hold for at least 40 minutes. They put you on hold w/o warning you too. You talk, but then you hear music. They are just terrible. I cannot wait to be done with them. I keep on warning everyone. Don't buy from them or lease.

reviews.author: Nedko
reviews.review_text: I WAS Toyota customer since 2010. I had three lease terms of 36 months. Two Orlando Florida 2010-2016 with the leasing of two Corolla 2011 and one Corolla 2013 one Rav4-2013 and one 2016-2019 in Toyota East Coast NJ leasing 2 Rav4 2017. Last June I went to the Toyota East Coast and ask for two new Rav4 2020. I was offered a price for lease $440 ($3000 down) and after a long battle with the dealer, it came to $390 ($3000 down). When I went to VW for VW Tiguan I was offered $275 ($3000 down) for two. I went Jeep of Teterboro and I was offered $219 ($3000 down) for a Compass and $319 ($3000 down) for a Grand Cherokee Laredo with all extras I asked for. When I returned back to Toyota East Coast and talked to the dealer nothing happened. I bought the Jeeps with three months in advance of my Toyota Financial lease and returned the old Toyota to the leaser. Here started the show. I was charged almost $1000 each returned car for leaving Toyota. They could not give me a competitive price and at the same time charge me for leaving the brand. DO NOT BUY/LEASE ANY CAR TOYOTA! They will slave you for life with high prices and bad financial service. NEVER MORE WITH TOYOTA! I have proof for every word of this post.

reviews.author: Hewad
reviews.review_text: I bought couple call from them but I have so bad experience with Toyota financial company. My car got crash six month before and my insurance paid off all the money for them. They still did not take care of the car yet. They’re moving so slow. They are getting money so fast but they don’t take care of you in the way have to be. I would recommend for everybody don’t trust them. I will never going to trust him again. And from past three months I’m trying to reach them they’re not answering the phone. Every day more than an hour waiting on the phone for them to answer my call but they don’t answer that just saying they’re busy.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial closed my account after a payoff was submitted (early on a Wednesday), processed my payment, then informed me through an automated message days later (Friday night of the same week, long after Toyota Financial was closed) that my bank payment was rejected. Since the account was closed, however, I have no way whatsoever to access my saved bank information to determine if there was a routing number error, account error, etc. Due to the late timing of the automated message, this means that Toyota Financial notified me of a serious account problem, but left me no way at all to attempt to correct it until their call center opens again after the weekend. Because the account was closed, I can't even submit support tickets--or, it may be better to say that it appears that I can submit them, but I can't view past tickets and it isn't clear if my submitted tickets are actually being processed. I have no doubt at all that Toyota Financial customer service will be very helpful once the call center opens again, but this review is to point out the problems with the online payment system as a whole. It is profoundly consumer unfriendly to put a system into place that notifies a customer of a problem, but then leaves the customer powerless to resolve the problem by denying access to bank, support, and most other information through account closure.

reviews.author: Duval
reviews.review_text: I leased my first Lexus GS 300 the first year they came out, 1991. Since that time I have renewed my Lexus lease for a new GS 350 or RX 350 9 times, the last being a 2017 RX 350. Additionally, I began leasing Toyota Tundra Crew Cabs about 12 years ago and have leased 4 Tundra. That makes for at least 13 Toyota/Lexus leases since 1991. All lease payments paid on time, every time. In September of 2017, Hurricane Harvey flooded our home and we did not have flood insurance. After two years of repairs and losses, as well as a divorce this Spring, I fell behind in my payments for three months. All the accounts were frozen during the divorce proceedings and cash was scarce. Last night my 2017 leased Toyota Tundra was surreptitiously taken from my driveway. This morning I have learned I owe $34,000 on the lease, I do not have possession of the truck, they are going to "auction" my pristine truck with - ready - 17,800 miles after 3 years. The lease is up Sept 20, less than 30 days. I am told Toyota Financial has no leeway. Well, after 29 years of being an incredibly loyal customer, I do. I will never step foot or lease another Toyota product. 29 years of on-time lease payments and three months of late and I will lose a substantial amount of money when I can least afford it. Thank you, Toyota!!

reviews.author: Shelly
reviews.review_text: LFS and TFS have system billing issues and CS issues. There is a small corp to address escalated issues. Their execs allow the abuse. I am going into arbitration but we need to get a class action against Lexus and protest outside their HQ. Contact me at **.

reviews.author: Alejandro
reviews.review_text: I made a large payment over the phone but it never posted. Well for nearly a week it didn't. I ended up going online and making a bank transfer to pay off the balance in full. The next day the first payment goes through so I call TFS and was told that the overpayment would be refunded to me through a check. So 2 weeks later I still didn't receive the refund so I call TFS and at first they didn't see the overpayment which was over 10k$. Was on hold and they finally found it. So my issue is. I had to call and request a refund for my money which I already had informed them about 2 weeks prior. I literally just loaned them over 10k and they had no plans to return it to me unless I complained about it and request my refund. If I owed them 10k they would charge me interest and now they had the intention to just keep my dough until I asked for it back. Shameful...

reviews.author: Rachael
reviews.review_text: Filed a complaint with the FCC. Thinking about hiring a lawyer. I'm shocked that there isn't a civil lawsuit already against these pigs! I have phone call recordings & paper trails that are screaming proof of errors on their behalf. Regardless of my fault in the matter, or any procrastination that was made on my end, none of the above is even close to measuring up, having been compared to the gross incompetence that was displayed by MULTIPLE reps. I asked for a hardship from my $320 payment in February of 2019 due to my fiance losing his job, among other unfortunate circumstances that are too private to share. It was granted, withdrawn, then refunded. To explain, a rep made me fess up to & re-live a horrible trauma in order to "qualify" me for the hardship. Having me in tears, she agreed to offer me the hardship for the current month, and also told me that I would qualify for the month of March as well if I needed it. What she didn't tell me at the time was that I apparently had an account with them online that I needed to log into and change a setting in order to prevent the payments from coming out anyway (I didn't find this out until around May.) That $ was all that I had to my name at the time. I found out the hard way that the $ was taken out anyway (on my birthday.) I wasn't able to celebrate my daughter's 8th birthday that weekend due to having to wait for them to reimburse the check. Also, my bank charged overdraft & transaction fees to my account in order to cover the payment. Toyota Financial agreed to pay for those fees, but the beginning of the damage was already done. Same thing happened in March of 2019, but we didn't get the check until May. More damage was done, and more fees from the bank were added. Come April 2019, they tried YET AGAIN to take MORE money from my account, which was still overdrawn BY THEM due to the previous month, adding to yet even MORE fees that were still owed to me from February & March (They only reimbursed me for about $30 of the almost $200 in fees, even after my bank sent them proof.) During the 3 months that Toyota Financial either took my money, tried to take my money, & accumulated for me a beautiful pile of fees, they had the nerve to say that they weren't responsible for any bank fees that were charged as a result of another company trying to withdrawal an automatic payment. I'm sorry, but not only did they not cover all of fees that THEY racked up, but let's remember that had they not taken the money from my account like they agreed not to in the 1st place, I would of been able to make those smaller payments that were due to other companies! I was at their mercy, despite plenty of proof of wrongdoings on their end! Eventually my bank account was forced to shut down. Before that happened, my mother deposited an emergency $50 into my savings to help us put food on the table since Toyota Financial was holding our check hostage, but my bank decided to eat that up before we could use it to pay for TF's fees. Unbelievable. Even more damage done. Oh, & CHECK this one out, the CHECK for March was never coming, BECAUSE NO ONE EVEN BOTHERED TO ISSUE IT! Then, the brilliant mind of a "supervisor" named Oz decided to try and refund me for the month of April, which would of been impossible considering the fact that there was no money that was taken for that month to begin with! But hey, at least they piled on those fees that month, right? Come May, like I said, I FINALLY got my check. I was then told that I didn't need to pay until June 2019. I. Was. Shocked. After all of the hell they put me through these last several months, waiting for money that they agreed not to take in the first place during a time when I didn't have 2 nickels to rub together, only for it to finally show up...& then to be told that it would need to be almost immediately returned back to them, just added further insult to injury. I was granted 3 full months (they added another month for their continued failures) for approved hardships. What I got was 3 months full of added on hardships due to their gross negligence! Then, they had the nerve to tell me that I used up my "3 month period", which just so happened to fall within the same time-frame as their mistakes! Apparently during hardship months, it's common practice for TF to hold people financially hostage, ruin a damn good credit score (mine was in the high 700's - now I'm afraid to even look at it), break-up relationships between folks & their credit union, & damage other client & business relationships! If that wasn't enough, things got way worse. Due to not having hardly any income at all to cover bills before the 2nd check came, I was forced to work less hours. It's impossible fill a gas tank when we are counting change, especially when I have to drive all over town (& sometimes out of town) for work. Eventually, I got laid off. My car insurance was one of those companies that withdrew their payment from my checking account automatically. Of course, with no $ in my account, Geico tried to pull the payment 3 times, & it resulted in fees. Inevitably, the policy was canceled, because I was waiting on the check from TF. I wasn't going to risk driving without insurance, but why does it seem like the bad things only happen to good people? Oz never called us back to discuss further terms regarding the "3 untouched months of hardship" that they promised us in the 1st place. We called him back several times because we were still owed fees, & his comment about having to make a payment in June made me nervous. The 3 months that would of qualified from there on out would of been May (check finally received & month was free of tampering after I went online & cancelled payment), June (bank account was closed but they tried to process payment again anyway), & July (same action in June happened in July - hopefully both months didn't tack on more fees). As soon as I got that check, I knew the battle wasn't over. We were tired of having to call back repeatedly, only to have to explain the whole story to a Level 1 Rep & then to hopefully to a Level 2 Rep, which rarely happened or went anywhere. Level 2 Rep's weren't calling back anymore. Funny thing is Toyota was blowing my phone up for payments, yet I figured someone would read the damn notes and know not to bug me until August 2019, unless it was about what they still owed me in fees. But no one investigated, & it turned out the joke was on me. Come middle of August, I was ready to make a payment. Since I knew I was legally right, I figured it would be no problem for TF to subtract what they owed me from the payment. Before I could act, I noticed early one morning that my car was missing from my gated community. I found out by calling the police that it was repossessed in the middle of the night. The second I called TF, their automated system recognized my # and hung up on me. We called from a different # that wasn't on record in order to bypass the system, and finally made it to a Level 1 Rep. She informed us that we couldn't use their service anymore. We demanded to talk to Oz since he knew our case. She then told us that he wasn't "available" for the day & that she would leave a message for him from us. She then proceeded to give us the # that we needed to call in order get my car back. My fiance tried calling the repo man (we got his # from the police), who was extremely rude, and refused to give my fiance even the cross-streets of his business, let alone any other pertinent information (even though he is listed on the account with TF). When we finally called the # that the rep at TF gave us, we were connected to a Level 1 Rep who heard the whole script from our mouths. She said the she could grant us an extension, but in order to get the car back, we had to pay June-August, as well as repo fees. When we contested this, & and told her that we had evidence, she transferred us to a "supervisor" Level 2 Rep. This lady was very condescending, & a real piece of work. She basically told me that since I had an account with TF, it was my responsibility to know how it worked. Therefore, the non-authorized payments were a direct result of myself at fault. BS! Even the supervisors at TS admitted after hearing the phone call recordings that it is the agent's job to explain, especially when most accounts are set up by the guy who is selling you the car while you sit across from him. He never explained that I could access it, or that it was even there to begin with. Next, she said I should be grateful to get 3 hardships (she could care less that they made things worse for me due to employee error). She often interrupted during my testimony, which is a scare tactic to try and throw me off my game so she can remain oblivious to the facts. I told her that I was still going to pursue justice, and reminded my fiance that we had already filed a complaint with the FCC & other legal parties. We have evidence recorded, as do they. Even my credit union saw the scam for what it was and issued paperwork in our defense in order to handle the fees. This lady, like the repo guy, didn't want to talk to my fiance either. She tried to tell me that I needed to pay for May-August, including repo fees, in order to get my car back (& I wouldn't qualify for an extension). When I mentioned that the lady just 5 minutes before her told me different, she told me she didn't care. I even mentioned that I had a recording of Oz claiming that I didn't owe until June, that went out the window too. I guess she won't mind that her call, as well as the call before her, were both recorded too. Cover your butts people! Otherwise, corporations & their sheep will walk all over you! Now starts a whole new game! I choose to break free from the havoc that they have unleashed when they chose to royally mess with my family's financial life and future. Had they done the right thing to begin with and had at least tried to amend their wrongs by starting with the bare minimum, they would of acknowledged that Feb-April were months full of no error on my behalf and would of made sure that those months would have be added on to the end of my contract as a complimentary gesture. Then, they should of finally granted me the 3 months that I was approved for "error-free" in the 1st place for the months of May, June, & July. Those 3 months would then pass freely, totally untouched. As a result of smooth sailing, and after having been able to finally catch my "financial breath", I would have issued my 1st payment, come the middle of August. Yet here we are, the payment is now ready, and my car is nowhere to be found. Good job TF. All I wanted was for you to do your job, right your wrongs, & do for me what was promised to begin with. Instead, I was taken advantage of, but never again! Bye Felicia!

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.review_text: They are the ONLY company I've ever dealt with that Intentionally OMITS on monthly invoices the date Late Fees are charged. So you don't know if it's after 10 or 15 days that they automatically charge their outrageous $32 late fee. Every car loan, mortgage, student loan, line of credit, credit cards, etc etc State on the invoice WHEN (how many days) a Late fee is charged. Not Toyota Finance as I'm sure they're making a Killing, big Profit on Late Fees. Seek Alternative financing if you don't want to be deceived!

reviews.author: Cathy
reviews.review_text: Hubby gets paid every other Saturday. Our due date is 21st. If I pay it on Sat. the 21st, Toyota says we're late. If 21st is on a Sun., and I pay it on the 20th, two days EARLY, Toyota says we're late. What right does a company have to say you're late when you paid on time or early? It's 2019; why do they refuse to acknowledge payments made online during the weekend? Don't EVER want to finance through them again!

reviews.author: Christopher
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services is at the very best a completely incompetent and at worst a downright predatory lender. I have made three payments since May 2019 on time. According to TFS, they never got them, and are now demanding I pay over a THOUSAND DOLLARS upfront this month or they will repossess the car. I have sent them bank records and statements proving that the payments were made on time (early, even!) with TRACING ID NUMBERS. They still refuse to credit my account! I've spoken with the bank personally to make sure that the payments were made! This is unacceptable thievery on their part. If I could describe Toyota Financial Services in three words: AVOID! AVOID! AVOID!

reviews.author: Hilary
reviews.review_text: I have talked to 6 different people here and they all say something different. This is without a doubt the worst customer service I have ever gotten. I truly don't understand how they can be THIS bad!

reviews.author: Kirill
reviews.review_text: I was happily leasing a Lexus through them (and I'm still a current customer). I have paid always on time, as I'm on autopay. Their site, btw, is user unfriendly, and it's hard to set up an autopay, but I did it. I turned in one of my cars after the end of the lease, everything was fine. 8 months later, I get a collection letter!! They claimed they send me a final bill once before (never got it, otherwise it'd be no problem to pay it). Then they turned me in to a collection agency! WTF?! They never even tried to reach me once! I get bunch of their promotion stuff by mail, email and otherwise, but this never attempted even once? Their collection agency (based in Philippines) SUCKS!! They don't answer the phone during normal business hours and their website doesn't take any of my good cards I use regularly. I'm stuck now. "Thank you", Toyota for a great "friendliness" and customer "care"! I'll remember this for a long time!

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.review_text: I don't know where I would be without this company. They have helped me with my payment throughout my medical problems and unable to work. No other company has ever cared as much as Toyota Financial Services. You are never judged at any point during a conversation. They make you feel like no matter the situation you are in they are there to help you every step of the way. I appreciate Toyota for everything. I will give 5 stars today, tomorrow, and always.

reviews.author: Elena
reviews.review_text: I have been with Toyota for going on 5 years now and never missed a payment. This month I ran into some financial hardships and asked to push down a month. After speaking to three representatives and a supervisor no one was able to help. How is it that after all this this of making payments one time and never having any problems with my account, they can’t do this one thing? Super unfair! Will not be getting any more cars from them!

reviews.author: jesus
reviews.review_text: Ok I paid the car payment on the 19 Friday. Today it's Tuesday 23 and this company haven't posted the payment. I need to know why this company continues to mess up my account and discriminate against me. This company it's not good. No one helps. They steal your money. If the car got a problem they don't do nothing to help even with warranty. Stay away.

reviews.author: Beatrice
reviews.review_text: The experience was wonderful. The loan was great. Almost 0 interest rate. The customer service was great. Troubleshooting was fantastic. The car was exactly what we wanted. The loan went smoothly. We chose to take a 5 year loan.

reviews.author: BillieJo
reviews.review_text: Toyota offered 0% interest with great credit. This was a huge deal to me so that I could save every penny I earn. They are easy to work with. Made my account available online, so that I could see all my transactions, estimate my payoff balance, and easily make payments. At the end of the loan, I had questions about how/when I would receive my title. They answered right away and explained to me the next steps. I would love to work with them again.

reviews.author: Pradeep
reviews.review_text: If you create an online profile in a financing website you will see how much is outstanding balance and how much your pay goes towards interest and how much towards your principal. You will never get those information in this shady company. Toyota is big company and they are not supposed to do this kind of low level techniques. Also when you click payoff it won't give you details, it will take you to another page where it will say, we give this offer that offer etc..

reviews.author: Christina
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial demonstrates the same quality and stature of the merchandise they represent. I have little to no contact with the finance company. The one time I did interface with the finance company it was pleasurable, prompt to my benefit and resolved within a timely manner as expected. I do now and will in the future recommend not only the product but their finance company.

reviews.author: Larry
reviews.review_text: I was able to qualify for 0% for 72 months - hard to beat, if not impossible, but need pretty good credit. Negotiated the deal for over 30 days but the financing was awesome! Toyota of Boerne was my dealer on a 2019 Toyota Tundra - great truck!

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.review_text: Company works with a rewards loyal customers. I compared other lenders including local credit unions; to that end Toyota was extremely competitive. At the the time the best option for me was extended loan payment. This may not be the best option in the long term but I needed the lower monthly payment according to my budget. My only criticism would be with the push of unneeded, unnecessary warranties on top of standard coverage. For instance “Bumper to Bumper” is a real ripoff- because it never applies to anything the consumer needs.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.review_text: It was 0% interest--you can't beat free. Contacted financing by phone on a few occasions, and customer service was very good. When car was paid off, title was shipped to me promptly and the item was off my credit report immediately.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.review_text: I've purchased several Toyota vehicles over the years & always used Toyota Financial Services. I possess a credit rating generally over 800 & my loans with TFS are approved immediately. One can source all the info they want on the TFS website. You can track your payments on each car you have financed. There are no pre-payment penalties as I always pay off early. Works well for me.

reviews.author: Glenda
